# extrude

> Tool to run a composite web application to easily interact with python functions

- [extrude.crude](extrude.crude.html.md): Control complex python object through strings.
- [extrude.multi_app](extrude.multi_app.html.md): Entrypoint for dispatching multiple child applications with a navigation root.

- [extrude.util](extrude.util.html.md): Utilities for specifying and splitting DAGs into sub-DAGs.
